plugin.name: REA
plugin.description: Investigate how any app, binary, website or package works, with every finding kept on a case that cites its evidence.
guidingWords.understand: Understand how the PDF export in this app works, with evidence.
guidingWords.trace: Trace which code sends this network request and show me the call chain.
guidingWords.spec: Reverse the clipboard behaviour of this binary and write a spec I can implement.
skill.investigation.name: REA
skill.investigation.description: Run an REA investigation end to end: pick the route, probe with evidence, record what is confirmed, inferred or still unknown.
agent.investigator.name: REA Investigator
agent.investigator.description: Reverses how an application, binary or website works and reports findings with their evidence.
tool.caseOpen.label: Open investigation
tool.caseRecord.label: Record finding
tool.caseStatus.label: Read case
route.electron.label: desktop app
route.electron.summary: Unpack the JavaScript bundle, map the main-process IPC and follow the renderer call into it.
route.javascript.label: JavaScript bundle
route.javascript.summary: Read modules, imports and source maps exactly as shipped.
route.website.label: website
route.website.summary: Drive the real page, capture its network traffic and read the bundles that issue it.
route.native.label: native binary
route.native.summary: Disassemble, decompile and follow cross-references in a configured engine.
route.dotnet.label: .NET assembly
route.dotnet.summary: Read metadata and IL with no extra engine installed.
route.android.label: Android package
route.android.summary: Decode the manifest and dex, then read the method behind the feature.
route.evm.label: EVM bytecode
route.evm.summary: Decode the dispatcher and selectors offline.
route.artifact.label: asset or archive
route.artifact.summary: Inspect headers and inventories for models, Godot packs, WASM and crash reports.
route.unknown.label: unrouted
route.unknown.summary: Identify the format first; the route decides which tools can produce evidence.
report.title: REA case report
report.specNotice: Written from observed behaviour. Fill in the parts the investigation did not settle, and keep the evidence references when you implement it.
action.investigate.prompt:
Investigate this {{kind}} with REA: {{path}}

First call case_open with this path and ask me which behaviour I want to understand if I have not said. Then pick the route the target actually needs. If the path is a container, disk image, installer or archive that has to be mounted or unpacked before it can be read — or if the extension is ambiguous — say what you need and how to get it, instead of guessing at contents. Record every finding on the case with its grade, and use case_report when I ask for the result.
tool.caseReport.label: Render case report
